Name: Pokemon Day Care - Fish
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pokemon Day Care - Fish[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Go fishing for Pokemon[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Pokemon fishing[/b]: about 230 Pokemon can be caught across the valley: beach, rivers, lakes, forest, mines, sewers, desert and Ginger Island. Each one keeps its own season, weather and time of day.[/*]
[*][b]Shinies[/b]: every Pokemon has a shiny version. The shiny rate is configurable, from 0 (never) to 1 (always, for testing).[/*]
[*][b]Crab pots[/b]: crab pot catches become Pokemon (Krabby, Corphish, Shellder...) and are still edible.[/*]
[*][b]Fish ponds[/b]: the water takes the colour of the Pokemon's type, ponds give items linked to that type, and pond quests never ask you for another Pokemon.[/*]
[*][b]Pokemon wording[/b]: "fish" becomes "Pokemon" in menus, dialogues, mail, quests, events and dishes, and named species (sturgeon, squid...) take the name of their Pokemon. Vanilla and SVE.[/*]
[*][b]Collections and aquarium[/b]: Pokemon fill the Fish collection tab, the aquarium and the Community Center bundles.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Replace the fish, or keep them[/b][/size]
You choose in the config (Generic Mod Config Menu):
[list]
[*][b]Replace the vanilla fish[/b] (default): the vanilla fish become Pokemon (icon, name, description, texts, ponds).[/*]
[*][b]Keep the vanilla fish[/b]: uncheck the option and the vanilla fish stay exactly as they are. The Pokemon that replaced them are added next to them as fish of their own, in the same spots, seasons and hours, with their shiny, their pond and their place in the aquarium.[/*]
[/list]With both options unchecked (vanilla and SVE), the Fish collection grows to 568 entries.

[size=4][b]Expansions[/b][/size]
Each expansion has its own toggle, working the same way:
[list]
[*][b]Checked[/b]: the expansion's fish become Pokemon, and its fishing spots get extra Pokemon.[/*]
[*][b]Unchecked[/b]: the expansion's fish stay as they are, and the Pokemon that replaced them are added next to them as fish of their own, in the same fishing spots of the expansion maps.[/*]
[*][b]Not installed[/b]: its Pokemon can still be caught, in the vanilla valley.[/*]
[/list]Supported: Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, Sunberry Village, East Scarp, Mount Vapius.

[size=4][b]With the main Pokemon mods[/b][/size]
Fish works on its own. With [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098]Pokemon Eggventure[/url], fish ponds also give the type's energy and, once full, the Pokemon's egg to hatch. With Pokemon Day Care, they give the type's energy and sea items.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI[/*]
[*]Content Patcher[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu (optional, recommended to change the options)[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
Unzip into your Mods folder. Changing an option takes effect the next morning (or when you reload your save).
To uninstall, remove the folder: caught Pokemon turn back into Error Items, so sell or ship them first. The same goes for the Pokemon added next to the fish if you check an option back on.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pokemon is © Nintendo / Creatures Inc. / GAME FREAK inc. This is a free fan-made mod, not affiliated with them.[/*]
[/list]
